## `neuro.json.stringify`

Static method on `JSON`.

> Converts a JavaScript value to a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) string.

## Signatures

```ts
stringify(input: { value: any; replacer?: (this: any; key: string; value: any) => any; space?: string | number; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
stringify(input: { value: any; replacer?: (string | number)[]; space?: string | number; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `JSON.stringify` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
